sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner had love affair with the informant/victim girl and they submitted an application for registration of their marriage.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim had relationship with another boy and the petitioner subsequently withdrew the application for registration of their marriage and as a result of which the informant/victim has lodged this FIR with the allegation of sexual assault towards the victim.

On the other hand, Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed in granting the privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner and submits that the bail prayer of the petitioner may be considered on perusal of the case diary.
I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties.
It appears that both the petitioner and the informant/victim are major.
It is apparent that whatever they had done according to their own volition.

However, considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties as well as the averments made in the petition, this Court is of the view that till a final decision is taken on perusal of the case diary, the petitioner, above-named be granted the interim protection till the next date fixed.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the petitioner, named above, in connection with Gossaigaon P.S. Case No. 343/2023, registered under Sections 376/511/354/323 of IPC, he shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

Page No.# 3/3 The direction for pre-arrest bail is subject to the conditions that the petitioner:
(a) shall appear before the Investigating Police Officer within ten days from today and shall co-operate with the investigation;
(b) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
List on 06.12.2023 for production of case diary along with statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
